For home service contractors

Is your website costing you calls?

We inspect your website the way you'd walk a job before quoting it. Every page. Every listing with your name on it. And whether ChatGPT gives out your number when a homeowner near you asks for someone in your trade.

What's changed

Google now puts an AI answer on top of roughly half the searches it handles, and more homeowners are skipping the results entirely and just asking ChatGPT. Here's why that should worry you.

A page of Google results shows ten businesses. An AI answer names two or three, then stops. There is no page two.

You're either on that short list or the homeowner never hears your name.

Here's the part most contractors don't know. The AI often isn't quoting your website at all. It's quoting Yelp or the Better Business Bureau talking about you. In a study of 318 million AI answers, Yelp was behind roughly 72% of local business citations in Google's AI answers. On ChatGPT, the BBB came first.

So if those listings are missing, wrong, or say something different from your website, that's what the homeowner hears about you. A perfect website doesn't fix it.

What we check

  • ✓Every page on your siteDead links, missing pages, pages that are copies of each other, pages too thin to be any use.
  • ✓Whether AI can read your site at allSome websites shut it out and nobody ever tells the owner. We test it and show you what came back.

What we found on the last one

Flooring contractor · 176 pages checked
  • ✗152 pages were the same page copied over and over, one for each town, four times through
  • ✗13 links went to pages that don't exist, including Gallery and Special Offers, both sitting in the main menu
  • ✗2 pages were showing raw computer code to anyone who clicked them
  • ✗The phone number on the website wasn't the one on Google. The old one belonged to a marketing company he'd already left
  • ✗Pages built by that old marketing company were still live on his site
  • ✗Not one page answered a question a real customer would ask

None of it showed up in his website traffic report. He had no idea any of it was there.

What we won't do

You've probably been pitched some of this already.

  • ✗We won't hand you a score out of 100You get the actual problem and what we saw, so you or your web guy can check it yourself. The report ends with one line you can paste in to confirm the biggest finding in ten seconds.
  • ✗We won't promise to make you number one in ChatGPTThere's no such thing. Ask it the same question twice and you get different companies. What's real is how often you get named, and that we can move.
  • ✗We won't tell you to buy a directory membershipEvery listing we check is free to claim and free to correct. BBB accreditation, for example, runs several hundred dollars a year and buys you a seal. It does not buy your rating, and you don't need it for your profile to be right.
  • ✗We won't sell you the trendy add-onsThere's a file some companies charge to install that no AI company has confirmed it even reads. If a fix is cheap and probably useless, we'll say so and you can skip it.
  • ✗We won't tell you to change what's workingAnything already earning you calls goes on a do-not-touch list at the top of the report.

How it works

  1. You send your website address and the towns you cover. That's the whole setup.
  2. We do the inspection. You spend about ten minutes on your phone running a short list of questions we send you.
  3. Five business days later you get the report, the to-do list in order, and the call.
